scope: Fresh postprompt synthetic proposer diagnosis; no final thesis qualification or model promotion
sampling: One stochastic sample per case, with at most one audited syntax retry per generated file. No seed was fixed.
input_provenance: Two new engineering-authored briefs and mockups. Independent oracles were frozen before inference and excluded from model prompts. All originals and rejected attempts remain retained.
isolation: Docker non-root1000:1000, read-only root/source, network none, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges,512MiB,1CPU,64pids;35s timeout per test command.

findings: Initial app.js contains literal backslash-n tokens outside JavaScript strings; the audited syntax retry retained both originals and returned parseable code.

The accepted app.js retry exports the factory directly with unguarded module.exports = createGuestList, contrary to the specified shared classic-script/named-export contract. Three independent groups cannot call the named export; the fourth actually raises ReferenceError: module is not defined on classic-script startup. This does not establish that the underlying state algorithm is wrong.

All eleven model-authored Node tests are registered and pass using the directly exported factory. Their imports and assertions were reviewed; no caught-assertion false-success pattern was observed in this suite.

HTML also required a syntax retry, then failed the exact design structure check: duplicate screen/control markers, a duplicate Back control and missing transition targets. No browser application was published.
Both app.js attempts contain an ESM export function declaration, prohibited by the selected WEB_STATIC classic-script profile; the second attempt is retained after the bounded retry is exhausted.

The final native code passes two independent numeric-allocation/conservation groups under Node26, whose default loader can import this ESM source. These partial passes do not waive the classic-script profile rejection.

The final code omits integer validation of totalCents: the independent invalid-input group fails because0.5 is accepted instead of rejected. Classic-script startup separately fails on the export keyword.
The model test file and HTML were not generated because core validation stopped the pipeline. Their quality and design conformance were not assessed.

decision.recommendation: Targeted proposer supervision is justified for JSON/source encoding, classic-script/CommonJS interop, typed input validation, exact screen/control markup and transitions. Validate every supervised source and test; retain this unchanged baseline for the bounded candidate comparison.

candidate_comparison_plan.candidate_runtime_config: Root agent must provide a verified candidate config before execution.
candidate_comparison_plan.cases_and_oracles: Reuse the exact frozen cases file and verify its SHA256 equals cases_sha256 above.
candidate_comparison_plan.harness: Reuse this exact harness and the same source-generation prompt implementation.
candidate_comparison_plan.comparison: Compare exact source disposition, each independent test group, model-authored test validity and mockup contract; preserve all retries and latency. No automatic adoption.
candidate_comparison_plan.sampling_limitation: One stochastic base/candidate sample per case is diagnostic only. Changing the baseline to deterministic decoding after observing it would make a different experiment; any repeated-seed study requires a separately frozen protocol.
training_exclusion: All oracle files, original response bodies and result directories for these diagnostics.

limitations: Cases differ from the earlier sales-tax/temperature diagnostic, so these scores do not estimate a causal prompt-improvement effect.
Classic-script VM startup is an isolated execution check, not a browser navigation, rendering or accessibility test.
Node26 may load an ESM file that the selected classic-browser profile correctly rejects; partial numeric passes are reported separately.

The named-export checks enforce the explicit generation contract. The guest-list state checks fail before invoking the directly exported factory; eleven separate model tests provide limited evidence for that factory logic.
Two narrow cases and one stochastic sample each cannot establish generalization, training quality or production readiness.
